parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.8954). The increase in MATRIX_LR to 0.08 was too unstable for my current configuration. Reverting to my best (0.8740). Next: I'll try testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it stabilizes the training, as others have reported success stacking it with depth-8.
parsed.description: Revert MATRIX_LR to 0.06 and add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize training.
